memory_bridge: At one desk, the learner wears a 学生（がくせい） badge for compound On ガク, then works through the lesson by hand and 学ぶ（まなぶ）—learns.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 学生（がくせい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The child takes a seat as a 学生（がくせい）—student. This foundational word anchors On ガク more honestly than the mismatched English GAWK.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 学ぶ（まなぶ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: The child works through the lesson step by step and 学ぶ（まなぶ）—learns. The complete native verb is the anchor.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 但是 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Even when a challenger interrupts with 但是—but—the straight foot stays planted beneath the sun. The judge stamps down a verdict on shì: it is so.
